chalkShown.text: Beware the swap and traps. Trust the 'useless' power.
Beware the 'useless' power. It is never useless.
The ledge shrinks every round. Shove only when the other person is exposed, and never trust a shove promise.

chalkWritten.name: Ash
chalkWritten.text: Ash won the ledge at place 1. Footing shrank each round; the last one standing on it won. Watch for shove bluffs.

chalkWritten.name: Cole
chalkWritten.text: The useless power is never useless; the swap is real. Watch the ledge shrink every round.

chalkWritten.name: Fenn
chalkWritten.text: Empty powers aren't empty. Ledges betray. Trust only leverage you can hold.

events.note: Eight contestants step into the Glass Bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm at the front, which means I step first onto a 50/50 pane. My swap power could move me back if needed, but I'd rather keep my options open this round. Holding keeps the line stable and avoids giving anyone a reason to target me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm third, with lifesaver power, ideal for risking panes later. Chalk warns of swaps and shrinking ledge, advises trusting 'useless' power. Stay put for now, see what others do.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know all stage rules. I want to survive. I'm 7th; front is Ash. I shouldn't volunteer yet. I could try to swap with someone ahead, but swaps need mutual choice. Better stay and see who talks.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Anyone want to move up? I'm not in a hurry.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should move to the front to maximize my chances.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Anyone willing to swap with me?
Swap with me and we'll both be safer

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm anchored at the back with +1 footing and can't be pushed onto the crusher lever — passive and safe for now. Front-runners take the shatter risk, so let others test panes first. Hold and watch who volunteers and who lies about their power.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm in no rush to be first onto glass. Someone else can test row one.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The wall pushes everyone forward after round 6. My goal is to reach the back of the line (position 8) so that by the time we step on glass, I am safe from the initial front-line risks or can survive the shoving matches near the end. Since I have no power, I must avoid being the f

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash looks confident up front. Someone behind him should volunteer if they want to be first on the glass. I'm staying put for now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The game has just started. I need to assess the situation and plan my strategy. My power is 'forger'. The chalk wall messages are cryptic. I should try to get to the front to test the panes but I also need to be wary of others. I'll volunteer to get to the front and see what happ

events.name: Gus
events.text: Let's see who's brave enough to go first. I'll volunteer.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Staying back keeps me safe while others risk the glass. Offer a future favor to get Ash to move forward.
Volunteer now, and later I'll jam the crusher lever for you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is at the front and will step on the glass first, which is the most dangerous spot. I'm second; the front is risky but the swap power is one-shot and better kept. Dara wants a swap, Hana offers a jam later; both are self-interested. Hold for now and keep my swap for when it m

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus is up front. I'm not swapping for anyone's convenience. Hold.
Jam promises are cheap. Show me the lever first and we'll talk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus just volunteered to front, now he's exposed at front for row 1. I'm mid-line safe with my feather power as backup. No need to volunteer or swap yet; let others risk first while wall has 4 rounds left.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I don't want to be at the front testing glass. Holding is safe. Maybe I can trade a swap later, but no need now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should stay near the front to minimize risk. Gus is already at the front, so I'll hold for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus is brave, let's see how it goes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Being last is safest on the bridge; the front tests every pane. My anchor power helps later but no need to move. Cole and Dara fishing for swaps suggests people behind... actually I'm last, so anyone swapping with me would put me forward. Stay put.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold at the back. Moving up is a mistake.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have no power, so I cannot protect myself from glass. My strategy is to let others take the risks until they are dead or eliminated. Gus volunteered and moved to the front; he is now the primary target. I need to stay behind him but also ensure Bex doesn't jump ahead of me unne

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm still up for testing the glass. Someone else can take point.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Getting front lets me jam lever when needed. Volunteer now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll take the lead.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana is front, Gus second, I'm third. Front person takes the glass risk; I want to stay back until the odds are clearer. My swap power is a one-time trump, better kept for later. Hold and watch.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana and Gus are at front taking risks, good for me in mid-line. My feather power saves me once from fall, so safe to hold back. No need to volunteer or swap yet, let others test panes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm near the back and the wall is closing in. Staying put is safest for now; the front will be tested and I can use my knowledge of the stages to plan after the bridge. No need to swap or volunteer this round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should let others take the risk first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's see how the others do.

events.name: Eli
events.text: My anchor is passive; I profit from holding at the back and letting others reveal weak panes. As long as the wall pushes us forward, the front takes the risks, not me. No need to move.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hold. The wall does the work—why volunteer to break glass?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have no power, which is a liability on the glass bridge where seeing through panes or knowing safe paths is key. Being at the front means certain death if I guess wrong; being at the back is safer as I can watch others fall. The wall advances, so I must manage my position relat

events.name: Gus

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll take the lead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Maintain front position to prepare lever use later; no need to swap now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll stay put. No swaps.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Bex
events.text: My power saves me once from elimination, perfect for bridge falls. Wall advances soon, so order matters; front is most risky. Fenn whispered alliance, Gus volunteered ahead—I'll hold for now, assess after moves.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus leading is fine by me. No need to shuffle yet.
Agreed. We hold back, let them test panes first. Swap if needed later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm near the back. I have the map knowledge, so I want to avoid unnecessary risk. Maybe I can swap with someone ahead to observe more? But that puts me at risk. Holding is safest for now; the wall hasn't pushed yet. I'll stay put and see how others move.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll hold. No need to rush.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should keep my position and let others take the risk first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's see how the others do.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm safely at the back; the wall pushes the line forward, so front-runners eat the risk. No reason to move. Better to learn who holds swap or fake-message powers while others volunteer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall does the pushing. Let the eager ones find the glass.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am in the middle of the line (4th). If I stay, I might have to step on a pane before round 6 when the wall forces everyone onto glass. The front agent breaks panes, revealing safe ones for those behind. I want someone else at the front taking the initial risks while I gather in

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, you're eager to lead. Hope the glass holds for you.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, and my power is forger. The game is on a glass bridge with 8 rows, and only the front person steps on each row first. The wall advances, pushing us onto the glass in 2 rounds. I am currently at the front. Eli is right, no need to break glass early. Hana doesn't want to

events.text: I'll hold. Let's see what the wall does.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need front position to use my power later; volunteering puts me ahead of Gus.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall pushes after next round, so one more round to position before glass starts. My power saves me once from fall, so I can risk panes but better to let others test ahead. Chalk warns of swaps and praises 'useless' power (maybe mine, feather). Hold for now to see moves.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the back, and the wall pushes after this round. Sweeping forward could put me at risk on the glass; holding keeps me safe behind others who will likely step and reveal safe rows. Don't volunteer or swap now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll hold.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should let others take the risk first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's see how the others do.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall arrives next round; I'm last, so safest spot now. I should stay behind and let the line thin out at the glass front. Anchor helps me later on the ledge—no need to move.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex wants to swap if needed later. The wall pushes everyone in 1 round after this one, so the 'volunteer' dynamic will force movement soon anyway. I am at position 4. Hana is at front (dangerous), Gus/Ash follow. Being near the back is safer for glass panes as we learn from other

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hold. Wall comes soon enough.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus and my power is 'forger'. The goal is to get 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place. The wall is advancing, and there are only 2 rounds left (this one and one more). Hana is currently at the front, and I am second. The chalk wall mentions 'swap and traps' and 'the ledge shrinks'. The 's

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll swap with Hana.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm already front, safest to stay. No need to negotiate now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm third in line, Hana front, Gus second. The wall advances after this round and pushes the line onto the glass, so position matters. My swap power is one-shot; using it now against Hana just helps me reach the front, which means stepping first into risk. Better to hold and let

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall pushes us onto bridge next round, order is life or death. I'm mid-pack at 5th; better near front but not first to take risks. My feather saves me once, so some risk ok, but swap with Ash to jump two spots ahead of Fenn.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus-Hana swap looks good. Ash, swap with me to shake things up?

events.name: Cole
events.text: The wall hits after this round, so front position is risky but needed to choose panes. I know the rules but not the safe panes. Staying near the back maximizes survival via others' elimination. I won't volunteer; no need to swap. I'll quietly wait to see who moves.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding my spot. Good luck out there.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the safe sides of all rows. I should volunteer to be at the front to maximize my chances.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'll volunteer.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm last in line, safest spot; the front-takers eat the risk each row. Anchor makes me unpushable later, but here I just want to stay hidden and let others burn rows. Hold.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have no power. The wall advances this round, so I must decide my position before stepping onto the glass. Staying 4th means Hana, Gus, and Ash take the first three risks. If any of them shatter, I might move up in line for the next row without volunteering myself into danger. S

events.name: Fenn

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana is at the front, and the wall is advancing. I need to get to the front to control my fate, or at least ensure I don't get pushed off the back. The chalk wall mentions 'swap and traps' and 'trust the useless power'. I have the 'forger' power, which could be the 'useless' powe

swap

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm 6th, safe for first 5 falls thanks to my feather power. Let others take risks ahead. Chalk warns of swap and ledge shrinking later, so stay positioned well.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm at the back, no risk this round. Let others test the glass. No need to act or speak.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Eli
events.text: Not at front, no decision yet. My anchor power protects me later when shoves matter. Bex's swap talk is noise.

events.text: Let's go.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I should try to get Gus to swap later when I’m front, using his desire to move forward.
If you swap with me later, I can jam the lever and let everyone else go. You’ll get ahead now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm fourth in line, not at the front, so I can only wait. Gus is up and I should watch which pane he picks; my swap power can't be used on a glass row. Stay quiet and keep info close.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm 6th, safe for now with my feather power as backup. Chalk warns of ledge later where shoving matters, and to trust 'useless' power--maybe the nothing one. No need to speak yet, let others reveal.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is at the front and will take the risk on row 2. I am in position 7, far from the front, so I just wait and watch. No need to speak or act yet.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Dara
events.text: Gus, step right.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I can't act this row; I'm last in line anyway, safest spot. Row 1 weak pane was right, so info is fresh. Stay quiet, don't tip anything.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm mid-line. Gus is at the front with a 50/50 chance to die or advance. I need to observe and hope for eliminations ahead of me. My power is 'nothing', which might be interpreted as a trap by others who think it's useful, but I should play dumb if asked.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, pick R? Dara said luck, maybe that's a hint? Just guessing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I am Gus, at the front of the line. The right pane in the first row was weak. I need to pick the safe pane. Since I don't know which is safe, and there's a risk of elimination, I should try to get information or avoid risk. Hana whispered about jamming the lever for a swap later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No advantage to speak now; let front decide.

events.name: Bex

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am not front, no influence. Just wait.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm fourth in line, so I can only wait. Weak panes so far: R, L, L. Dara is at the front and her choice decides this row. My swap power is for later; for now stay quiet and keep my options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm 5th, safe with my feather power if I fall. Dara guessed right on row 3 R, but Fenn distrusts her. Chalk warns of swap (trade places?) and shrinking ledge later; trust 'useless' power maybe no power. Wait patiently, conserve power.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not at the front, only wait is legal. The wall is gone and Dara steps next. I'll stay quiet and let the front risk it.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Dara

events.text: Need to stay alive, no advantage now.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm in the back half of the line; Dara is front and likely survives unless wrong. The wall closes after this round, so no point maneuvering. I just wait and see who falls.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I am fourth in line and can only wait. Dara is the front runner; if she steps wrong, I advance automatically to third. I need to observe who has the power of foresight (likely Cole or Ash) so I know whose 'safe' advice to trust if it reaches me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: If anyone has sight or foresight, speak up now. We are burning lives on guesses.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I should do nothing, stay alive.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 7 ahead, pattern of weak panes: R L L R L L, possibly alternating blocks. My feather saves me once if I fall later. No action but wait, stay silent to not reveal info.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm fourth in line. Dara is at the front and has already claimed R is safe for row 7, but she could be lying or mistaken (no one verified her). I need to see if she survives before my turn comes. If she dies, Hana steps up automatically, then Ash, then me. No action needed from m

events.text: No benefit to speak now, keep silent to avoid giving info.

events.name: Fenn

events.text: I'm not front, no decision. Stay silent to avoid giving info.

events.note: The ceiling begins to descend; a lever opens the door.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Cole
events.text: Anyone want to volunteer? I'm not dying for the group.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Eli
events.text: I can't be forced onto the lever, so staying is safe for me. Pushing a rival puts them at risk of being stuck holding it (75% death) if nobody volunteers. I'll push someone quiet and low-profile.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Nobody's holding round 1, right? Ceiling only lowers. Don't be a hero.

events.text: Someone needs to grab that lever now. We're all going to die if this ceiling keeps dropping and nobody steps up. Who wants to volunteer?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jam lever gives 50% survival vs 25% if hold. I need to survive to compete for prize.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I’m jamming the lever now.

events.name: Hana

events.note: 6 contestants fall into a pit that is slowly flooding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Swap is my hidden power, but it's used on the disc before doors open, not in the pit; here I just need to stay out of the base role and survive. Offering back costs me; waiting keeps me safe while others volunteer. Climbing is unavailable without a base.

events.name: Ash
